reason: All 30 sample directories were completed, but the PowerShell 5.1-incompatible final hash conversion failed after sampling. The previous script retained exact durations only in process memory and wrote neither a run manifest nor per-sample timing records, so exact percentiles cannot be reconstructed without fabricating data.
remediation: windows-demo-smoke.ps1 now persists a provenance manifest before sampling and one sample-result.json after every clean sample. windows-demo-aggregate.ps1 can aggregate those records offline without launching the application.
